notes:
A RETIREMENT, NOT AN ADJUDICATION. row_count is 0 on purpose: this batch adds no row and records 13 being retired from the CERT C oracle. No verdict is changed anywhere.

WHY. aurora-lint 4a4ec2b2 moved three checks out of the CERT C ruleset into the CWE ruleset: MSC42-C, POS55-C and WIN05-C were never CERT C identifiers. The oracle is a CERT C oracle (aurora-lint ADR-0014 D1; maintainer ruling 2026-10-06, option (b): retire, do not re-key to CWE ids, no ADR amendment). Findings from the CWE ruleset sit outside CERT C precision and recall.

WHAT. All 13 labels under the three ids: MSC42-C 10 (curl 5 FP, hostap 5 TP), POS55-C 1 (mbedtls FP), WIN05-C 2 (ventoy FN). Selected by rule id as a census; nothing was re-read and nothing was judged.

ARCHIVED, NOT LOST. The rows are removed from data/*/adjudication.csv but stay complete in this repo's history at the parent commit, and each source manifest names every removed key under superseded_rows (which is how scripts/label_churn.py attributes a removal). They are seed material for a future CWE oracle. Postgres keeps them until benchmarking_db's drop_ground_truth_rows.py --keys runs, since the mainline sync never deletes; that step writes the full rows to oracle_corrections/.
